name: Royal Monastery of Santa María de Guadalupe
description: Tucked into the foothills of the Sierra de las Villuercas in Extremadura, this fortress-like monastery in the town of Guadalupe was begun in the 14th century. Its buildings blend several styles built up over four centuries. Pilgrims have long come to see its celebrated statue of the Virgin, which became a powerful emblem of faith in the Spanish-ruled Americas after Columbus's voyage of 1492.
